scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "chain,seed,backend,web" -c "yellow,cyan,blue,magenta" "npm run chain" "node scripts/wait-and-seed.cjs" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "node scripts/run-web-if-present.cjs"
scripts.test:core: node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('core/package.json')) require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix core test', {stdio:'inherit'}); else console.log('core not landed yet')"
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:backend && npm run test:core
scripts.build:web: node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('web/package.json')) require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix web run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); else console.log('web not landed yet')"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:web
